purpose: Define a boot profile as an explicit stable configuration identity that selects the runtime component set for an instance without changing the identities of selected components.

topics.name: Boot Profile Identity
topics.purpose: Define a boot profile as an explicit stable configuration identity that selects the runtime component set for an instance without changing the identities of selected components.

semantics.identity_rule: Every named boot profile has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.instance_rule: An instance references an exact boot profile/profile version or inline exact profile definition according to configuration contract.
semantics.selection_rule: Profile selects component identities/capability groups explicitly.
semantics.component_rule: Selected component identities remain independent from profile identity.
semantics.state_rule: Profile definition, resolved closure and active runtime state are separate.
semantics.path_rule: Profile filename/path is not semantic identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Selecting a component does not grant callers use/access authority.

invariants.rule: Boot/runtime availability is derived only from explicit profile selection plus validated dependency closure; discovery, installation, dependency presence or historical activation never silently enables a component.

hard_gates.condition: profile path used as semantic identity
resolved runtime state written back as canonical profile definition
profile silently inherited from previous boot

references.purpose: Runtime activation consumes an exact boot profile.
